construct: Lysosomes maintain an acidic lumen through vacuolar-type H+-ATPase (V-ATPase), which hydrolyzes ATP to pump protons into the organelle. The low intralysosomal pH is required for optimal activity of many acid hydrolases and for normal lysosomal degradation.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Normal synthesis and lysosomal targeting of hydrolases with neutralized lysosomal pH and reduced degradation localizes the defect to the ATP-dependent proton pump that acidifies the lysosomal lumen.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Mitochondrial F1F0 ATP synthase is another proton-coupled ATP enzyme, but ATP production is normal and that complex does not pump protons into lysosomes.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: Only lysosomal V-ATPase directly generates the acidic lumen required for acid-hydrolase activity.
